{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "27972db2",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Lifting and Query\n",
    "\n",
    "Features come per frame; lifting moves them onto the 3D scene. Each 3D point looks itself up in\n",
    "every keyframe that sees it and averages those features. Afterwards you can search the mesh with\n",
    "text. This page lifts Talk2DINO features by hand, then queries the mesh the `semantics` stage\n",
    "lifted."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "86ff3ea5",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-09T07:01:21.285974Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-09T07:01:21.285701Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-09T07:02:28.386851Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-09T07:02:28.384018Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import pyvista as pv\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "import transformers\n",
    "import trimesh\n",
    "import zarr\n",
    "\n",
    "from collab_splats.pointcloud import PointcloudResult\n",
    "from collab_splats.preproc.frames import frame_idx_from_path, frame_paths\n",
    "from collab_splats.semantics import (\n",
    "    FeatureAutoencoder,\n",
    "    Talk2DinoExtractor,\n",
    "    read_point_features,\n",
    "    write_point_features,\n",
    ")\n",
    "from collab_splats.semantics.lifting import lift_features, transfer_features\n",
    "from collab_splats.utils.torch_utils import batch_iterator\n",
    "from collab_splats.utils.visualization import apply_view, camera_view\n",
    "\n",
    "%run ../tutorial.py\n",
    "\n",
    "# Hide a harmless checkpoint warning from Talk2DINO\n",
    "transformers.logging.set_verbosity_error()\n",
    "\n",
    "scene = tutorial_scene(\"preproc\", \"pointcloud\", \"mesh\", \"semantics\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "1cd5b164",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 1. Features per frame\n",
    "\n",
    "Extract Talk2DINO features for every keyframe, in the point cloud's frame order:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "a82afbb4",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-09T07:02:28.392806Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-09T07:02:28.392349Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-09T07:02:42.143289Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-09T07:02:42.141638Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "96 maps of (768, 32, 18), 0.16 GiB\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# The point cloud with depth and confidence; lifting needs both\n",
    "cloud = PointcloudResult.load_zarr(scene.pointcloud_zarr, load_world_points=False)\n",
    "paths = frame_paths(scene.images_dir, [frame_idx_from_path(p) for p in cloud.image_paths])\n",
    "\n",
    "extractor = Talk2DinoExtractor()\n",
    "maps = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for (batch,) in batch_iterator(4, paths):\n",
    "    maps.extend(extractor.forward(batch))\n",
    "\n",
    "stacked = torch.stack(maps)\n",
    "print(f\"{len(maps)} maps of {tuple(maps[0].shape)}, {stacked.nbytes / 2**30:.2f} GiB\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "eb4bda3d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 2. Compressing\n",
    "\n",
    "Storing a full feature vector per point is costly, so a small autoencoder learns to squeeze each\n",
    "one into 64 numbers and back. The reconstruction cosine says how well it comes back: 1 is\n",
    "perfect. It is measured on the training data, so read it as \"the fit converged\"."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "4478fc04",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-09T07:02:42.148792Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-09T07:02:42.148643Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-09T07:02:45.347004Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-09T07:02:45.344035Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "reconstruction cosine 0.950 after 8 epochs\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "features = stacked.numpy()\n",
    "ae = FeatureAutoencoder(input_dim=features.shape[1], latent_dim=64)\n",
    "ae.fit(features, epochs=20, target_cosine=0.95)\n",
    "print(f\"reconstruction cosine {ae.recon_cosine:.3f} after {ae.epochs_run} epochs\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Each frame's map as 64-D codes\n",
    "ae.cpu()\n",
    "\n",
    "with torch.no_grad():\n",
    "    codes = [ae.encode(fmap) for fmap in maps]"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "97efe964",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 3. Lifting onto points\n",
    "\n",
    "`lift_features` projects each point into every frame, keeps the frames whose depth agrees with\n",
    "the point (so hidden points are skipped), and averages their codes. Saving writes the codes and\n",
    "the autoencoder; reading decodes back to full features."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "99f3ecd9",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-09T07:02:45.351889Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-09T07:02:45.351380Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-09T07:02:48.747413Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-09T07:02:48.745762Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "500,000 points, 768-D features\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "point_codes = lift_features(codes.__getitem__, cloud).numpy()\n",
    "\n",
    "store_path = work_dir(\"lifting_and_query\") / \"talk2dino_lifted.zarr\"\n",
    "write_point_features(store_path, point_codes, ae)\n",
    "point_features = read_point_features(store_path)\n",
    "print(f\"{len(point_features):,} points, {point_features.shape[1]}-D features\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fe79196a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 4. Querying the mesh\n",
    "\n",
    "The `semantics` stage did the same lift onto the vertices of `mesh.ply`. A vertex no frame sees\n",
    "has no feature and is drawn grey below.\n",
    "\n",
    "Load the stage's per-vertex features:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "bf7ac293",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-09T07:02:48.751508Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-09T07:02:48.751333Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-09T07:02:51.037529Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-09T07:02:50.950648Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "98.9% of 335,017 vertices observed\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "lifted = scene.lifted_stores[\"talk2dino\"]\n",
    "raw = np.asarray(zarr.open(str(lifted), mode=\"r\")[\"vertex_features\"])\n",
    "observed = raw.any(axis=1)\n",
    "vertex_features = torch.from_numpy(read_point_features(lifted, name=\"vertex_features\"))\n",
    "print(f\"{observed.mean():.1%} of {len(observed):,} vertices observed\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "3157748f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Score two prompts on every vertex, as on the feature extraction page. `transfer_features` then\n",
    "averages each vertex's score with its 8 nearest neighbors, which smooths noise and fills small\n",
    "gaps."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "3dbb5245",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-09T07:02:51.042445Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-09T07:02:51.042019Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-09T07:02:51.866575Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-09T07:02:51.865120Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "NEGATIVES = [\"object\", \"background\", \"ground\", \"sky\"]\n",
    "tree = extractor.score_queries(vertex_features, positive=[\"tree\"], negative=NEGATIVES)\n",
    "can = extractor.score_queries(vertex_features, positive=[\"trash can\"], negative=NEGATIVES)\n",
    "scores = np.stack([tree.cpu().numpy(), can.cpu().numpy()], axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Smooth the observed scores over neighboring vertices; unreached vertices stay grey\n",
    "mesh = trimesh.load(scene.outputs[\"mesh\"], process=False)\n",
    "vertices = np.asarray(mesh.vertices, dtype=np.float32)\n",
    "smoothed = transfer_features(vertices, vertices[observed], scores[observed], k=8)\n",
    "smoothed[~smoothed.any(axis=1)] = np.nan"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "f44c80fd",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "\"tree\" and \"trash can\" on the mesh, seen from the side. Yellow matches the prompt; grey was never\n",
    "seen:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "9366f67d",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-09T07:02:51.871030Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-09T07:02:51.870871Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-09T07:02:54.273316Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-09T07:02:54.271850Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/jpeg": "",
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<PIL.Image.Image image mode=RGB size=1400x500>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "surface = pv.wrap(mesh)\n",
    "plotter = pv.Plotter(shape=(1, 2), window_size=(1400, 500))\n",
    "\n",
    "for col, (prompt, values) in enumerate([(\"tree\", smoothed[:, 0]), (\"trash can\", smoothed[:, 1])]):\n",
    "    plotter.subplot(0, col)\n",
    "    plotter.add_text(prompt, font_size=10)\n",
    "    plotter.add_mesh(\n",
    "        surface.copy(),\n",
    "        scalars=values,\n",
    "        cmap=\"viridis\",\n",
    "        nan_color=\"lightgrey\",\n",
    "        lighting=False,\n",
    "        scalar_bar_args={\"title\": f\"score: {prompt}\"},\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "plotter.link_views()\n",
    "apply_view(plotter, camera_view(cloud.extrinsics, vertices))\n",
    "plotter.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4c5e741e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The trunks should light up for \"tree\" while the ground stays dark. Each panel has its own color\n",
    "range, so the trash can stands out even though its scores are lower."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "7d8be4b4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In a pipeline run\n",
    "\n",
    "The `semantics` stage does all of the above for every keyframe and writes\n",
    "`<backend>/semantics/talk2dino_lifted.zarr`. `max_epochs` caps the autoencoder fit.\n",
    "\n",
    "```yaml\n",
    "semantics:\n",
    "  enabled: true\n",
    "  extractors: [talk2dino]\n",
    "  max_epochs: 20\n",
    "```\n",
    "\n",
    "To query interactively, open the scene in the viewer and pick the store from its Semantics menu:\n",
    "\n",
    "```bash\n",
    "python -m collab_splats.viewer data/tutorial_scene/vggt_omega --port 8080\n",
    "```"
   ]
  }
 ],
